acknowledge_prior_failure.description: Acknowledge an exact prior failure and request one audited caution-level retry. Does not bypass unrelated Guard blocks.

action.description: Natural-language description of the action the agent is about to take.

failure_window_hours.description: How far back to check failed tool events. Defaults to 168 hours.

files.description: File paths to fingerprint in the required guard receipt.

include_capsule.description: If false, omit the embedded Memory Capsule from the response.

include_status.description: Include memory health in the response and warning calculation. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Max recall results to consider before preflight categorization.

mode.description: Underlying capsule mode. Defaults to conservative.

scope.description: agent restricts memory recall to this server agent identity. shared searches the whole store. Defaults to agent.

session_id.description: Session identifier for grouping the required guard receipt event.

strict.description: If true, high-severity memory warnings produce decision=block instead of caution.

success_checks.description: Required result comparisons fixed before execution. A mismatch records failed; an unavailable check prevents a succeeded outcome. Pass the actual output to memory_guard_after.

parseJson.description: Parse the selected string as JSON before comparing its scalar value.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the output supplied to memory_guard_after; empty selects the output.

tool.description: Tool or command family about to be used, e.g. Bash, npm test, Edit, deploy.
